quest.summary: My hearth went cold the year the bells began. Does a fire kept by hand hold through one whole night?

offer: This hearth by my door was kept every night, once. Then it was not.
Light it before dusk. Feed it until dawn. What is looked after stays.
waiting: Before dusk, light it. Then wood, all night, until the sky goes grey.
done: It held, the whole night. What is looked after is not forgotten.
Take this. Herbs and cord, the way we bound a hurt once.
